mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy support.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month sustained increase in unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO decline > 5% YoY) during late-cycle expansion periods indicates supply chain stress and reduced industrial output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as growth expectations fall.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO decline >5% YoY during late-cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS >4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates policy response to inflationary pressures, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as markets anticipate accommodative measures supporting growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL rise and FEDFUNDS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market downturns (HOUST decline >10% YoY), S&P 500 returns become negative over 20 days as real estate sector weakness reduces consumer confidence and spending, amplifying recession risks.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with HOUST decline >10% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
